summary_zh: 今日泰國焦點在EV轉型：汽車零件業受EV投資浪潮衝擊，約75萬名勞工就業受影響，產線與技能需同步調整。同時BOI與工業聯合會推動半導體與Data Center供應鏈在地化，新供應商認證與產能導入壓力持續上升；央行亦預期MPI修訂將使今年GDP成長增加0.1至0.5個百分點。
summary_en: Thai auto parts makers face EV-driven restructuring affecting about 750,000 workers. BOI and FTI push local semiconductor and data center supply chains, raising supplier qualification pressure. The central bank expects MPI revisions to add 0.1–0.5 pts to GDP growth.
